items.headline: Typhoon disruption pushes dry bulk rates higher
items.summary: The Baltic Dry Index climbed to a three-week high after Typhoon Dolphin tightened Capesize vessel availability in the Pacific, per Bloomberg, lifting rates for iron ore, coal and grain cargoes.

items.headline: EU ETS reform proposals could reshape ETRM needs
items.summary: ComTech Advisory published an interview on the European Commission's proposed EU ETS reforms, noting the cap-and-trade scheme's declining allowance cap will push firms toward cleaner alternatives or scarcer allowance purchases, with implications for ETRM vendors.

items.headline: Commodity trade finance seen growing to $135bn
items.summary: Standard Chartered's commodity trade finance head highlighted market consolidation, digitisation and supply-chain diversification driving the sector, projected to reach roughly $135 billion by 2030.

items.headline: AI-driven reporting gains traction in CTRM tools
items.summary: Per ComTech Advisory's CTRM Center, AI-powered reporting has become one of the most sought-after use cases for artificial intelligence among commodity trading businesses this year.
